_icons.{supply-small}: small Supply token placed on the board
_icons._typeIcon: All Cursed Item cards carry a pentagram type icon in the top-right corner
_icons._supply: Supply icon (stacked cubes) with a number or infinity = number of uses

cards.name: Binding Tablet
cards.text:
Lose 4 {lungs}, incurring {wound-facedown} if applicable. You may not use this Item if you have fewer than 4 {lungs}
The Adversary may take only the Move Action on their next turn

cards.name: Blood Chalice
cards.text:
Gain a {wound-faceup} to use any other Investigator's Major Ability without using a {major-ability} token. If their Ability uses special tokens, take those tokens even if they are on the board
You may choose Investigators that are not in play
You may not Trade this Item after using it

cards.name: Cursed Poppet
cards.notes: Card shows the Poppet special-token icon next to the pentagram type icon in the top-right corner

cards.name: Diablerie Book
cards.text:
After using this card, permanently increase your {footprint} by 2
At the start of each of your turns, flip a random {wound-facedown} face-up
If you do not have a {wound-facedown}, gain a {wound-facedown}
You may not Trade this Item after using it

cards.name: Foul Spell Bag
cards.text:
Roll a D6:
1-2: Permanently increase your {footprint} by 1
3-4: Your Flashlight may never drop below 1 {charge} for the rest of the game
5-6: You no longer gain {wound-facedown} from Sprinting
Roll again. Another Investigator must:
1-2: Place an {obstruction} (Obstruction) token on the highest space of their Stamina track
3-4: Place an {obstruction} (Obstruction) token on the highest space of their Charge track
5-6: Gain the Paranoid Condition

cards.name: Hexed Mirror
cards.text: After another Investigator gains a {blood} from the Adversary, you may change places with them

cards.name: Mystery Syringe
cards.text:
Roll a D6:
1: You may not Move or Sprint next round
2: You may not gain/lose {lungs} for the next 2 rounds
3: Lose 2 {lungs} (incurring {wound-facedown} if applicable) then flip a {wound-faceup} face-down
4: Regain all of your {lungs}
5: Increase your {footprint} by 2 for 2 rounds
6: The next time you Sprint, roll 2 Sprint dice and add them together

cards.name: Phantom Amulet
cards.text:
Gain the Mauled Condition to place a {secret-passage} (Secret Passage) token between any two spaces on the main board
If you already have the Mauled Condition, gain a {wound-facedown} instead

cards.name: Summoning Stones
cards.text:
You may look through the General Item deck and take 2 cards, then shuffle the deck
All Investigators must decrease their {lungs} by 1, incurring {wound-facedown} if applicable

cards.name: Lorgnette
cards.text:
Place up to 3 {supply-small} tokens on any space your Flashlight touches. These spaces count as if they have line of sight and have the same effect as your current Flashlight, even if they are obstructed or are not fully covered
Each time you use this Item, have the Adversary give another Investigator the Darkness Condition

cards.name: Witch Bells
cards.text:
You may choose to make the Adversary either not use a Sprint die or place their Shadow token on the main board where they begin their next turn
Gain the Darkness Condition when you use this Item

cards.name: Raven's Wing
cards.text:
You may Move through Map Hazards with no negative effects. If you do this, you may not use your Flashlight this round
You may not Trade this Item after using it

cards.name: Inscribed Axe
cards.text:
When the Adversary Attacks you, you may discard this card to choose another Investigator to suffer the effects of the Attack instead
Reduce your {lungs} to 0 (do not incur any {wound-facedown}) and place an {obstruction} (Obstruction) token on the highest space of your Stamina track
